method: Every published compressed tile decoded, checksum/length/schema/finite heights checked. Shared 128 m lattice edges compared. Counts de-duplicate stable source IDs. Eligibility is a metadata policy, NOT proof of physical traversability.
limitations: Lengths here include complete source ways at the border; coverage.json has administratively clipped source totals.
No departmental native traversal or visual/collision guarantee is inferred from a seam audit.
Pilot-to-department seam is a separate unresolved audit.
